title: ranunculus altaicus subsp. sulphureus
intro: Ranunculus altaicus subsp. sulphureus, commonly known as Golden Buttercup, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Ranunculaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Ranunculus altaicus subsp. sulphureus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of skin conditions, wounds, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory activities.
